### `ColorValue`

A color as written (spec 13 §13.1): any string form (hex, CSS functions, named, `$` reference),
or the canonical linear float object. Parsing into a working-space color is `rexx-color`'s job.

Any of:

- string: `"#FF3366"`, `"rgb(255 51 102)"`, `"oklch(0.7 0.2 20)"`, `"white"`, `"$theme.color.accent"`.
- `ColorObject`: Linear-light floats in the working space; may exceed 1 (canonical form).
